groups.title: Rebar machinery
groups.lead: Benders, cutters and processing lines for reinforcing steel.

groups.title: Sawing
groups.lead: Band saws, cold saws and the blades that go in them.

groups.title: Plate and section rolling
groups.lead: Plate rollers and slip rolls for cylinders and cones, and angle rolls that bend sections into rings and arcs.

groups.title: Sheet metal bending
groups.lead: Press brakes, panel benders, sheet metal brakes and the tooling that goes in them.

groups.title: Laser cutting and laser welding
groups.lead: Fiber lasers for sheet, plate and tube, and laser welding from handheld to robotic.

groups.title: Shearing, punching and notching
groups.lead: Shears, ironworkers, notchers and plate bevellers.

groups.title: Tube and pipe
groups.lead: Bending, notching and end forming of tube and pipe, and CNC wire bending.

groups.title: Pressing, riveting and HVAC forming
groups.lead: Hydraulic presses and riveting machines, and the circle cutters, bead rollers and lock formers of the duct shop.

groups.title: Deburring, grinding and finishing
groups.lead: Deburring and edge rounding, belt grinders and sanders, corner grinding and pipe polishing.

groups.title: Welding
groups.lead: Positioners, turning rolls, column and boom manipulators, welding tables and corner welders that take the hand work out of repeat welds.

groups.title: Drilling, milling and CNC machining
groups.lead: Drill presses, milling machines, CNC lathes, machining centres and surface grinders.

groups.title: Aluminum and vinyl (PVC) window machinery
groups.lead: Machines for window, door and curtain-wall fabricators.

groups.title: Woodworking machinery
groups.lead: Jointers, planers, saws and joinery machines for the cabinet shop and the joinery.

blurbs.press-brake: Hydraulic, hybrid, electric and compact press brakes, 16 to 1,323 US tons (15 to 1,200 t) — the Dener premium line and the NovoTech value line.
blurbs.panel-bender: CNC panel benders that bend all four sides of a panel without tool changes, 47″ to 165″ bend width.
blurbs.v-grooving-machine: CNC V-grooving machines for sharp architectural bends — horizontal to 20 ft, vertical to 1/4″ plate.
blurbs.folder-sheet-metal-brake: Magnetic brakes, box and pan brakes, hand brakes, hydraulic, electric and CNC folders, roofing brakes and 3-in-1 machines.
blurbs.horizontal-press-brake: NC hydraulic horizontal presses for bending, straightening and punching, 11 to 165 US tons.
blurbs.press-brake-tooling-punch-and-die: EUROSTAMP punches, dies, holders and adapters for every clamping style, made in Italy.
blurbs.laser-cutting-machine: Fiber laser cutting machines for sheet and plate, 4 × 4 ft to 10 × 164 ft beds, 1.5 to 80 kW.
blurbs.tube-laser-cutting-machine: Tube and profile fiber lasers for Ø0.3″ to 25.2″, 20 to 40 ft bars, 1.5 to 40 kW.
blurbs.laser-welding-machine: Handheld laser welders from 0.8 kW, robotic laser welding cells to 20 kW, and laser cladding.
blurbs.shear-cutting: Hydraulic and mechanical shears — swing beam and guillotine plate shears, electric, bench and light hydraulic shears, 20 ga to 1-9/16″.
blurbs.ironworker-machines: Hydraulic ironworkers and punching machines that punch, shear, notch and bend in one machine.
blurbs.corner-notcher: Hydraulic and pneumatic corner notchers for the corners of boxes, cabinets and panels.
blurbs.plate-beveler: Cevisa portable cold bevellers for weld preparation on plate and pipe, 1/8″ to 4-3/4″ thick, and value-line edge chamfering machines.
blurbs.band-saw: Manual, semi-automatic and automatic metal-cutting band saws — Bekamak premium and NovoTech value lines.
blurbs.band-saw-blades: WIKUS bimetal M42 and carbide-tipped band saw blades, welded to length for your saw.
blurbs.circular-cold-saws: Circular cold saws from manual to CNC carbide — ISITAN, CSM, Bekamak and NovoTech value line — and abrasive saws.
blurbs.aluminum-and-pvc-upcut-saws: Automatic upcut, double-head, glazing bead and miter saws for aluminum and PVC extrusions.
blurbs.plate-rollers: Hydraulic 4-roll and 3-roll plate rollers, motorized plate rollers and slip rolls, from 22 ga sheet to heavy plate.
blurbs.angle-rolls: Angle rolls, profile benders, ring rollers and tube rollers for angle, flat bar, pipe and profiles.
blurbs.hydraulic-press: Hydraulic shop and bench presses from 10 tons, H-frame and four-column presses to 661 US tons, C-frame presses and straightening presses.
blurbs.riveting-machine: Hydraulic orbital riveting machines for solid rivets from Ø3/16″ to Ø1-3/16″.
blurbs.bead-rollers: Bead rollers, beading machines and round-duct beading and slitting machines for HVAC duct, auto body and sheet metal work.
blurbs.lock-former: Pittsburgh lock formers, roll formers and a pneumatic lock seamer for HVAC ductwork.
blurbs.circle-cutters-and-seamers: Circle cutting and flanging machines for tank ends, dished heads and duct fittings.
blurbs.pipe-benders: CNC, NC, all-electric and hydraulic pipe and tube benders, Ø15/32″ to Ø8-5/8″.
blurbs.pipe-notcher: Tube notchers, hole-saw and end-mill notchers and belt tube-end grinders for frames, railings and roll cages.
blurbs.tube-end-forming-machines: Wecotech tube end forming machines from Switzerland — expanding, reducing, beading and flanging.
blurbs.wire-bending-machines: CSM CNC 3D wire benders fed from the coil, Ø5/32″ to Ø9/16″ wire.
blurbs.welding-automation: Welding positioners from 22 to 44,092 lb, turning rolls to 220,462 lb, column and boom manipulators and welding tables.
blurbs.welding-positioners: Benchtop, tilting, heavy, rotary-table, lift and headstock positioners, 22 to 44,092 lb.
blurbs.welding-turning-rolls: Light, adjustable and self-aligning turning rolls to 220,462 lb, pipe and fit-up rotators, pipe stands.
blurbs.column-and-boom-welding-manipulators: Column and boom manipulators, 31.5 to 275.6″ lift and 39.4 to 315″ boom.
blurbs.welding-tables: A fixture welding table with a 2″ hole grid and downdraft tables to 3,700 CFM.
blurbs.corner-welding-machines: GECAM 1- to 4-axis TIG and plasma corner welders for bent boxes, cabinets and enclosures.
blurbs.sheet-metal-plate-deburring-edge-roundin: Gecam wide-belt deburring, edge rounding, deslagging and brush machines, 5-7/8″ to 53-1/8″ wide.
blurbs.corner-grinding-machines: Gecam corner grinders for the weld seams of boxes, cabinets, doors and tube frames.
blurbs.pipe-sanding-polishing-machines: Automatic, orbital and centreless pipe sanders and polishers, Ø3/16″ to Ø15-3/4″.
blurbs.tube-end-deburring-machine: The Eurofintec 143 deburrs cut tube and pipe ends inside and outside in one cycle, Ø13/16″ to Ø4-3/4″.
blurbs.rebar-bender-and-cutter: GMS rebar benders, stirrup benders, rebar cutters and automatic processing lines, made in Turkey.
blurbs.pvc-aluminum-window-machines: Plastmak aluminum and vinyl (PVC) window and door machinery — welding, cleaning, CNC machining, assembly and complete lines.
blurbs.belt-grinder: Metal belt grinders with 2 – 8″ belts, disc sanders, bench grinders, end-surface grinders and dust collectors.
blurbs.drill-press: Gear-head, inverter and column drill presses, 15/16″ to 2″ in steel, with power feed and tapping.
blurbs.milling-machine: Turret, universal and heavy ISO50 milling machines, drilling-milling machines, keyseaters and a head resurfacer.
blurbs.cnc-lathe: TTC and TTH slant-bed CNC lathes, 6″ to 12″ chucks, Fanuc control, C-axis live tooling.
blurbs.vertical-machining-center: TMC vertical machining centres, BBT40, and TDC double-column machining centres, BBT50.
blurbs.surface-grinder: TGH-B 450 precision NC surface grinder, 17.7 × 35.4″ table.
blurbs.woodworking-machinery: Jointers, thickness planers, table saws, band saws, slot boring machines, a lathe and dust collection.
